description: This file contains unit tests using the Vitest framework for functions imported from 'daemon-install-plan.shared.js', specifically testing 'resolveGatewayDevMode', 'resolveDaemonInstallRuntimeInputs', and 'resolveDaemonNodeBinDir'.

methods.name: resolveGatewayDevMode
methods.description: Determines if the given command array indicates a development mode entry point based on whether the script path contains 'src/cli/index.ts'.

methods.name: resolveDaemonInstallRuntimeInputs
methods.description: Resolves runtime inputs for daemon installation, with tests for overriding devMode and nodePath.

methods.name: resolveDaemonNodeBinDir
methods.description: Returns the directory path containing the Node.js executable, derived from the executable path.
